assessment_kind: Source-aware assisted authoring feasibility; NOT blind autonomous LLM benchmark or independent review

cases.description: Vector electrostatic force for two charges at distinct xy-plane coordinates (in 3D space).
cases.reference_target: Test coordinate-vector interpretation and SI units.
cases.qualification: Compute force from test charge times E; not a separate built-in force query.
cases.parameter_provenance: All physical numerical values are supplied by Q55; z=0 embeds the stated xy-plane. Display bounds are authored.
interpretation_notes: Static probe only: no mass is given, so no particle mass or trajectory is invented. The test charge is not also a field source.

cases.description: Superpose three infinite uniformly charged sheets and evaluate the field at P.
cases.reference_target: LLM authors signed densities, heights and field direction.
cases.qualification: Field undefined on ideal sheets; field-only scene.
cases.parameter_provenance: Q35 gives symbolic a,sigma and a figure placing P between the upper and middle sheet. a=1 m, sigma=1 nC/m^2, P=(0,0,1.5a) are labelled representative choices.
interpretation_notes: Use fixed charge sheets, not a conductor-response solve. Field-only; do not evaluate on a sheet. Plane potential references are implementation conventions, not specified absolute potentials in Q35.

cases.description: Four positive/negative corner charges; compute both V and E at square centre.
cases.reference_target: Test simultaneous scalar cancellation and vector addition.
cases.parameter_provenance: Signs and square arrangement from the source figure; a=2 m and q=1 nC are representative. Centre chosen as origin.
interpretation_notes: V=0 does not imply E=0. Point locations excluded from samples.

cases.description: Two concentric shells carry charge with equal surface densities; potential at common centre.
cases.reference_target: Derive individual Q from equal sigma and total Q, then calculate centre V.
cases.parameter_provenance: Q122 supplies symbolic Q,r,R and equal surface densities. Q=5 nC, r=0.5 m, R=1 m are representative; split charges are derived from area ratios.
interpretation_notes: No grounding, contact charging or arbitrary conductor polarization is inferred. No shell trajectories.

cases.description: Four equal point charges on cardinal axes; V and E along the perpendicular z-axis.
cases.reference_target: Test 3D axial sampling, symmetry, zero field at centre.
cases.parameter_provenance: MC33 provides locations in terms of a and common q. a=1 m,q=1 nC and the sample z values are representative.
interpretation_notes: The native viewer shows a central slice, not an automatically generated V(z) graph; numeric observations are separate.

cases.description: An offset infinite line charge passes through a spherical Gaussian surface; compute net flux.
cases.reference_target: Compare quadrature with enclosed line length and Gauss law.
cases.qualification: Increase quadrature/convergence checks near off-axis line; do not sample line singularity.
cases.parameter_provenance: The source gives lambda,y,R with R>y. Choose lambda=1 nC/m, y=0.6 m, R=1 m; choose a z-parallel line at x=y and Gaussian centre at the origin.
interpretation_notes: The line pierces the integration surface twice. Engine docs exclude certification of such surfaces; avoiding quadrature nodes on the axis is NOT enough to establish accurate flux. Preserve this case as a limitation diagnostic. The Gaussian surface is not rendered by the native scene schema.

cases.description: Negatively charged particle projected across a uniform downward electric field.
cases.reference_target: Compare 3D numerical trajectory, displacement and kinetic energy with parabola.
cases.parameter_provenance: Q99 gives symbolic q,m,E,v and directions. Values here are representative nonrelativistic inputs. Duration/samples are authored.
interpretation_notes: The question asks for the incorrect statement; option A omits the nonzero initial kinetic energy. Do not silently replace total kinetic energy by its change.

cases.description: Negative test charge released on perpendicular bisector of two identical positive charges.
cases.reference_target: Simulate symmetric motion and verify energy at the midpoint.
cases.qualification: Assume fixed source charges; compare crossing speed from potential.
cases.parameter_provenance: Q28 gives the symbolic values and initial position (0,sqrt(3)a). a=1 m,Q=1 nC,q=1 microC,m=1 g are representative.
interpretation_notes: Sources are fixed. Crossing is estimated by a separate bracketed interpolant of saved states, not a built-in stop event and not a force from the display grid.

cases.description: Unequal fixed point charges create a zero-potential circle; examine a released test charge.
cases.required_components: Two fixed PointSource objects + one Particle
cases.reference_target: Check zero-potential locus in a plane and the crossing speed.
cases.qualification: 3D locus is a sphere; viewer does not yet draw equipotential isosurfaces. Exact crossing requires authored postprocessing.
cases.parameter_provenance: Solved Problem26 gives -2Q,+Q at +/-3a and release at the circle centre. a=1 m,Q=1 nC,q=1 microC,m=1 g are representative; centre/radius derived from V=0.
interpretation_notes: The question specifies an xy-plane circle. The 3D zero-potential sphere is an inference, not a different original question. Only the planar circle is tested here; native equipotential geometry is not implemented.

cases.description: Potential at a point near a uniformly charged solid sphere with an eccentric cavity.
cases.reference_target: Verify subtractive charge-volume composition and potential at P.
cases.parameter_provenance: All physical values come from NUM31; centimetres converted to metres. Charges are derived from the uniform density times each volume; cavity contribution is negative.
interpretation_notes: The negative sphere is mathematical removal of density, not a separate physical charged material. The unchanged viewer draws the two primitive sphere meshes and does not cut a geometric hole.

cases.section: Archive JEE Advanced, Multiple Correct 2013 Q5
cases.description: Partly overlapping uniformly charged spheres of opposite volume charge densities.
cases.required_components: Two overlapping SolidSphere sources of opposite strengths
cases.reference_target: Test unfamiliar overlapping distribution and field in overlap.
cases.qualification: Net densities add algebraically in the overlapped volume; no conductor model.
cases.parameter_provenance: The archive question supplies +/-rho, radii and partial overlap, not numbers. The chosen dimensions and density are illustrative; signs and equal densities are retained.
interpretation_notes: Opposite TOTAL charges would be wrong when volumes differ. Test matched densities instead. Sources are prescribed nonconductors.

cases.description: A test charge follows an elliptical Coulomb orbit about fixed opposite charge.
cases.reference_target: Reuse the same inverse-square orbital integrator as ideal-Sun gravity.
cases.qualification: Choose representative bound initial conditions; angular momentum and energy postprocessing.
cases.parameter_provenance: MC36 prescribes an elliptical orbit but supplies no orbital numbers. Charges,mass,a,e and 30-degree inclination are representative; pericentre velocity and period are derived.
interpretation_notes: Fixed source/test-particle, nonrelativistic Coulomb idealization. No radiation, atomic-stability or two-body backreaction claims. This is not a gravitational-corpus case.
